notes.title: 0.8 Progress
notes.notes:
Hello, long time no see! It's about time I give you guys an update on the development of the game!

Update 0.8 is in progress; it'll feature a new mini-game, new events, and new animations. The new mini game is smaller in scope but way more focused than the waitress mini game. Fluid animations are the number one request for the game. As I'm learning how to properly make them, more and more will appear in game!

It's hard to predict exactly when the update will be ready but it is expected to be released in about a month from now. (Early March). Patch note and release date will be shared a few day before release.

Thanks, see you soon for more!
